_comment: Site-wide pop-up. mode 'acknowledge' shows it each visit until the visitor clicks 'Don't show this again'; closing with X or Esc dismisses for that session only. Change 'id' for a NEW message. Other modes: 'once', 'untilDate' (with endDate), 'always'. A message can also run for a set time: "until" (YYYY-MM-DD) ends it and "then" holds the announcement that takes over. layout 'hero' is the big-photo card: hero.photo/alt/tag, 'logo' badge, 'laterLabel' (this visit) and 'dismissLabel' (for good).
